recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future dom-3 expression behavior should be handled through separate issues such as FHIR-43690, not by reopening this historical Schematron correction.
issue_request: FHIR-26307 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for DomainResource. It reported that the dom-3 Schematron XPath declared $id but used $contained, and a Jira comment added that the FHIRPath expression repeated as(canonical) where the second check should have been as(uri).
initial_application: The issue was applied by df2409c55d5f25c93d67bd6db2b71d6b9517e4de, which changed source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml to repair both the dom-3 XPath and the repeated canonical FHIRPath check. A same-family later issue, FHIR-27916, also corrected the dom-3 Schematron XPath and is already represented on the combined branch.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current DomainResource no longer carries ElementDefinition XPath/Schematron source because 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 removed XPath usage from the constraints. FHIR-43690 later simplified the dom-3 FHIRPath to select(reference | as(uri)); its resolution and Zulip review confirm that canonical/url are intentionally covered by uri, and that issue is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current source has no invalid dom-3 XPath/Schematron expression and no longer contains the repeated canonical fragment reported by FHIR-26307.
